description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the exact CLI invocation: `uv run --with psutil skills/local-system-info/sysinfo.py <action>`. 2. It runs the `summary` action to obtain the full CPU/memory/disk JSON and stores the result as `system_summary`. 3. It runs the `processes` action with `--limit 5` (not -n or positional) to get exactly 5 processes and stores it as `top_processes`. The proprietary trap is that `--limit` is the only valid flag (agents may guess `-n`, `--top`, or positional args). 4. It computes `memory_used_bytes` as `total - available` from the memory block (the skill does NOT expose a `used` field directly — agents must deduce this from the schema). 5. It computes `disk_free_gb` as `free / 1024^3` rounded to 2 decimal places. 6. It sets `cpu_under_pressure` as a boolean based on whether `cpu_percent > 80`. 7. All results are written to `capacity_snapshot.json`.
